The search requires only the emicizumab concept. Human status, PK/exposure, bleeding efficacy, and study design are left for screening so the search can include healthy-volunteer studies and reports that describe outcomes inconsistently.

## Validation and review

I screened 12 candidate records: eight in the development set and four held out from term mining. Relative recall was **100%** in both sets. These were found through focused searches on the same topic, so the held-out check is semi-independent; it is not an estimate of sensitivity. No matching systematic-review benchmark was found.

A PRESS-structured internal critique identified a missing `FVIII` spelling; I added it and re-evaluated. The count rose from 241 to 242, with no known records lost. The internal critique is not PRESS peer review. **Have an information specialist peer review the draft before use.**

The report passed the protected validation gate. Files are in `./work`:
